search.sort_fuel_hint: Choose the fuel price to compare

favorites.empty_subtitle: Tap the star on a station to add it here

settings.save_history_caption: Checks for updated price history once per launch and caches the last 90 days locally. Disable to keep your device free of history data.
settings.vehicles_caption: Add your cars to see driving costs and CO₂ at each station.
settings.vehicle_tank_caption: Calculations based on a full tank.
settings.error_invalid_number: Use a dot for decimals, e.g. 5.5
settings.worth_it: Worth it - you save €{{saving}}, trip costs €{{cost}}
settings.not_worth: Not worth it - trip costs €{{cost}}, savings are €{{saving}}
settings.ev_vs_gas_sub: Time for EV to be worth it
settings.ev_caption: Compare the total cost and CO₂ of an electric car vs a petrol/diesel car over its lifetime, including the one-time battery replacement.
settings.ev_becomes_cheaper: The EV becomes cheaper in year {{year}}
settings.ev_break_even_hint: Total so far = purchase + running + maintenance, plus the one-time battery cost. The EV is cheaper to run; this is the year its total drops below the petrol car's.
settings.ev_no_break_even: The EV never becomes cheaper at current prices
settings.ev_battery_note: The battery is replaced once at ~160,000 km (around year 13 at average driving). EV CO₂ uses the grid average; battery manufacturing CO₂ is counted once.
settings.ev_help_ev: EV charging per year - what you'd spend on electricity to drive that distance.
settings.ev_help_gas: Petrol fuel per year - what you'd spend on petrol/diesel for the same distance.
settings.ev_help_battery: Battery - replaced once at ~160,000 km (shown as a single cost, not every year). Replacement cost and its manufacturing CO₂ are included.
settings.ev_help_break_even: The EV costs the same (or more) to buy but less to run; this is the year its total cost so far drops below the petrol car's.
settings.ev_help_co2: CO₂ in kg - kilograms of carbon dioxide emitted per year from driving; the battery figure is a one-time manufacturing cost.
settings.donate_caption: Siphon is free and open source. If it saves you money, consider supporting the project.
settings.rewards_caption: Watch a short ad to unlock exclusive rewards and keep Siphon free.
settings.rewards_footnote: Ads are opt-in and never interrupt you. Watching one unlocks the next reward on the ladder.
settings.worth_unit_mismatch: This fuel can't be compared because the station price and your vehicle capacity use different units.
settings.worth_out_of_range: This station is beyond the configured one-tank range for this vehicle.
settings.worth_no_comparison: Not enough comparable stations within {{radius}} km to judge this trip.
settings.worth_full_tank_saving: Pump-price saving on a full tank: €{{saving}}
settings.worth_extra_trip_cost: Extra driving cost vs the alternative: €{{cost}}
settings.worth_trip_cost_saved: You save about €{{cost}} in driving vs the alternative
settings.worth_break_even_over_capacity: Even a full tank would not recover the extra driving cost.
settings.worth_net_loss: Not worth it - about €{{amount}} worse overall
settings.worth_estimated_distance: Using an estimated distance while real road routing finishes.
settings.worth_full_tank_assumption: Comparison assumes filling up to the configured vehicle capacity.
settings.worth_full_tank_extra: Pump price costs €{{cost}} more on a full tank
settings.ev_tco_caption: Compare the ownership cost of an EV and a combustion car using your mileage, consumption, energy prices and maintenance assumptions. No battery replacement is assumed by default.
settings.ev_pick_ev: Use consumption from an EV in My Vehicles
settings.ev_pick_ice: Use consumption from a combustion car in My Vehicles
settings.ev_result_ev: EV is cheaper in this scenario
settings.ev_result_ice: Combustion is cheaper in this scenario
settings.ev_result_close: Costs are very close in this scenario
settings.ev_break_even_electricity: At the other assumptions, EV running cost stays competitive up to about €{{rate}}/kWh.
settings.ev_method_note: This is a scenario calculator, not a universal claim. Purchase price, consumption, maintenance and energy prices are editable; resale and battery replacement are not assumed unless you add them in a future scenario.
settings.route_cache_caption: Road distances are saved permanently so repeated trips do not need another routing request. Clearing them will rebuild the cache as needed.
settings.ads_opt_in_caption: Rewarded ads are optional and only load after you choose to watch one. Privacy status is refreshed each launch.
settings.ev_already_cheaper: EV starts cheaper under these assumptions.
settings.privacy_not_required_body: Google's consent system does not require a privacy-options form for your current region or consent state. Rewarded ads remain optional.
settings.privacy_error_body: The privacy form could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

price_trends.history_disabled: Price history is disabled. Turn it on in Settings.
price_trends.weekday_insufficient: Need at least 2 weeks of history to show the weekday cycle.
price_trends.forecast_locked: Price forecasts unlock after 80 days of history for this station - {{days}} days to go.
price_trends.forecast_disclaimer: Statistical estimate based on the last 80 days. Prices depend on market conditions - not financial advice.
price_trends.no_fuels: No fuel price data is available for this station.
price_trends.no_history: No price history is available for this fuel yet.
price_trends.forecast_explainer: Uses this station’s recent trend, normal weekday pattern and a rolling historical backtest. Forecasts are estimates, not guarantees.
price_trends.forecast_unreliable: There are 80+ days of history, but recent backtests are not accurate enough to show a useful forecast.
price_trends.market_context: Current market context: {{pressure}} pressure. The numeric forecast is still based on backtested station history.
price_trends.last_change_unknown: No price change detected in the saved history.
price_trends.info_position_body: Shows where today's price sits relative to this station's observed prices over the last 30 days. It does not compare other stations.
price_trends.info_forecast_body: Forecasts appear after at least 80 days and only when rolling backtests are accurate enough. The likely range matters more than the single estimate.
price_trends.info_market_body: Market pressure is context only. It does not directly change the station forecast until that relationship can be validated against history.
price_trends.info_weekday_body: Each bar is the average price observed on that weekday. It can reveal recurring patterns, but it does not guarantee that a weekday will always be cheaper.

station.report_hint: Include the station ID from the details above when reporting.
station.payment_disclaimer: Payment info from official registry - may be incomplete

price_chart.insufficient_data: Only one data point - need at least 2 for a chart.

sync.no_connection: No internet connection. Connect to download station data on first use.
sync.rate_limited: Sync paused to avoid hitting GitHub limits. Try again later.

market.title: Market
market.insufficient_data: Not enough data to compute metrics yet.
market.insufficient_hint: Not enough price history yet - retail series and correlation metrics start appearing as history accumulates.
market.rocket_feather_desc: Prices rise {{rocket}}%/mo faster than they fall ({{feather}}%).
market.disclaimer: Statistical estimates based on historical data - not financial advice.
market.pass_through_ahead: Crude moved first; retail may still react over roughly the next {{days}} days.
market.pass_through_catching_up: Retail prices are moving in the same direction as crude and appear to be catching up.
market.pass_through_caught_up: Retail prices appear to have absorbed most of the recent crude move.
market.pass_through_unclear: No clear crude-to-retail pass-through signal right now.
market.details_pressure_up: Recent crude and retail movements lean upward. This is a directional signal, not a pump-price forecast.
market.details_pressure_down: Recent crude and retail movements lean downward. This is a directional signal, not a pump-price forecast.
market.details_pressure_neutral: Recent crude and retail movements do not point strongly in either direction.
market.details_lag_body: The strongest historical relationship has retail following Brent by about {{days}} days. Correlation is {{correlation}} ({{strength}}), so treat the lag as an estimate, not a schedule.
market.details_rocket_body: Historical rising-market pass-through is about {{rocket}} per month versus {{feather}} in falling markets. A large difference suggests prices react differently to increases and decreases.
market.details_volatility_body: Typical daily movement over the last 30 days: crude {{crude}}, retail {{retail}}. Higher volatility means short-term direction is less stable.
market.details_spread_body: Brent is currently {{spread}} relative to WTI. This shows divergence between major crude benchmarks, but it does not translate directly into the same change at the pump.
